title: Merek dan Karya Bukan Milik Bersama
author: Rahmat Wibowo
description: Advokasi dan kesadaran publik tentang hak cipta dan hak merek di ranah digital Indonesia, disusun sebagai opini hukum dan materi edukasi dengan empat studi kasus. Memuat kerangka hukum Indonesia dan eksposur internasional, analisis mens rea, konsekuensi hukum, seruan beretika di ruang digital, dan lampiran dokumentasi visual.
note: Hanya studi kasus 3 (klaim peran dan logo institusi pada personal branding, Abil Sudarman/ASSAI) yang menyangkut Abil Sudarman; tiga studi kasus lain menyangkut pihak lain. Dokumen menyatakan dirinya bukan putusan pengadilan dan bukan tuduhan pidana yang telah terbukti, dan para pihak yang disebut berhak atas praduga tak bersalah serta hak jawab.

en.title: Brands and Works Are Not Common Property
en.description: Advocacy and public awareness about copyright and trademark rights in Indonesia's digital space, written as a legal opinion and educational material with four case studies. It covers the Indonesian legal framework and international exposure, mens rea analysis, legal consequences, an ethical call for the digital sphere, and an appendix of visual documentation.
en.note: Only case study 3 (claims of roles and institutional logos in personal branding, Abil Sudarman/ASSAI) concerns Abil Sudarman; the other three case studies concern other parties. The document states that it is not a court ruling and not a proven criminal accusation, and that the parties named are entitled to the presumption of innocence and the right of reply.
